purpose: Recompute the Runner Division and H3 handoff census against the checked-in lab and OTR repository heads; no repository outside this lab was modified.

vram_recipe_lab.read_surface: git-tracked files only; untracked files were excluded

otr.read_surface: git-tracked files at HEAD only; the local OTR worktree was not modified

method.recipe_count: Count `git ls-files recipes/*.json` at the lab commit.
method.alias_selection: Inspect only tracked top-level `results/<stem>.json` files; exclude a stem containing `_run`; parse JSON; retain an object only when `recipe == stem`.
method.same_name_current_alias: A selected alias whose stem is a checked-in recipe stem.
method.orphan_alias: A selected alias whose stem is not a checked-in recipe stem.
method.modern_schema: Selected same-name alias with integer `receipt_schema_version >= 2`; all other selected same-name aliases are legacy.
method.appearing_warm: Selected same-name alias whose string `status` starts with `PASS` and does not contain `(cold)`, case-insensitive. This is a display predicate, not a promotion verdict.
method.active_runner_binding: Recursively search the selected alias JSON values for exact equality with the active `run_recipe.py` SHA-256.
method.otr_profiles: Parse tracked `config/profiles/*.json`, excluding paths containing `widget_mapping`; count objects with `status == shipping`; distinct engine IDs are nonempty `slot_overrides.video_render_engine` values.
method.otr_lanes: Count tracked `docs/evidence/lane_receipts/lane*.md`; require a `verdict PASS` header in each; inspect lanes 19 through 21 individually.
method.sage_correction: Read OTR `nodes/_otr_shared/boot_contracts.py:171-175` at the OTR commit and search launcher sources for `--use-sage-attention`.

h3_lane_packets: lane21-h3_low_mime: standalone and deliberately unregistered runner, PASS

sage_attention_metadata.finding: No OTR launcher passes --use-sage-attention; production runs Sage-free, so the lab Sage-free boot is production parity.
sage_attention_metadata.runtime_safeguard: The distinct H3 assert_sage_not_patched check remains live and is not the dead metadata field.
